slots.why: DUNGEONS.md section 1: 4 slots per dungeon, one strip each, 2,048 long in x and at most 64 wide in z, 128-block rows from z 1,024. Slot k of dungeon d is row (d-1)*4 + (k-1): its strip is z0 = rows_from_z + row * row_spacing .. z0 + strip_width_max - 1, x origin_x .. origin_x + strip_length - 1, its spine along +x at the strip's centre line z0 + strip_width_max / 2. tools/dungeon.py refuses any overlap with the portals' rescue box (z -512..768 on every x), Entei's band (z around -768) and the probe pack's row (z -704..-577, data/dungeon_probes.json), each recomputed from its own file
slots.overworld_coincidence: the rows are inside the overworld map's x/z bounds (data/world.json 0..8191), unlike Entei's (data/entei_boss.json pocket.origin_why). What that risks is the blackout's waystone arrival test, which compares coordinates and not dimensions (data/blackout.json checkpoints.waystone_jump_why): tools/dungeon.py refuses any slot's arrival point within waystone_arrival_radius + 1 of a town waystone in data/progression.json, and the keeper's own box tests are made dimension-safe by the dg.pk tag (a box test on @s is coordinate-only)
slots.clear_strip_why: false for the placeholder: the pocket is void, so the shell writes only its own boxes. A shell from an earlier, LONGER spine is not cleared by a later shorter one; set true for the first apply of the real spine (step 4) to air the whole strip first (I2, EXP-081: one 2,048 x 64 strip cleared in one function call stalls the server 2.64 s fresh). A re-apply step only, never at entry

dungeons.name: The Overgrown Temple
dungeons.test_why: one of the three full-length TEST dungeons the owner asked for on 2026-10-09 ('make a few test dungeons at full lengths. I want to see a real one ... if it is supposed to be a jungle room or something make it feel like a dense jungle'). Its rip stands by the Night Shift's on the carts' trail so the owner can walk from one to the other; where a real jungle dungeon belongs in the region (the Jungle Isle) is the owner's call after the look
dungeons.gate_flag_why: a test dungeon: open at 0 badges and every band, like the Night Shift (DUNGEONS.md 11.2), so the owner can enter it at any band
dungeons.shape_mix_why: pass 2 (the owner: 'really emphasize making rooms different shapes, not all boxes'): a room without its own `shape` takes the jungle theme's mix; most rooms here name theirs. The box-only kinds (maze, parkour, collapse bridge, set piece) and the stairs, vault and puzzle stay boxes
dungeons.clock_why: REVISED 2026-10-10 (unit BOSS2: the boss is two stages with a full heal between them, the owner): re-derived with tools/dungeon_clock.py (plus the set piece's 25 s) to 39 / 42 / 40 / 44 / 51 / 54 minutes, every band under an hour; the shortest clock sets the vault budget (data/dungeon_greed.json vault_budget): the derived clock without the 25 s (39 minutes at band 3) put the treasury's band-3 chest at 178 cp over a 175 cp budget, which the 25 s (40 minutes) clears. At band 1 the shorter clock cut the vault budget to 322 cp (76 a chest at 95%) and the treasury's chest, 79 cp, lost one Lum Berry (71 cp); at band 3 the budget (720 cp, 171 a chest at 95%) was under the Super Potion alone (175 cp), so the band-3 chest is 3 Potions and 3 Medium Exp. Candies (153 cp); band 4 lost one Lum Berry (193 -> 185 cp, under the 188 cp limit); band 6 is one Super Potion, 3 Potions and 3 XL Exp. Candies for two Super Potions and 2 candies (352 cp, over the 348 cp limit). Each of these is the test's own limit (95% of the budget over the chests), the budget being the shortest clock's; the required minutes and the boss share quoted below are the three-stage draft's and stand only as the record of how the walk and the other fights were priced. tools/dungeon_clock.py jungle (DUNGEON_ROOMS.md 7), re-derived by DG3-JUNGLE on 2026-10-10 over the four variants, each fork's slower route walked its own way (route_extras): at the gorge rim the poachers (two trainers) are slower at every band than the bridge or the streambed, at the fallen court the glyph door (a puzzle) than the roots. MAIN route required 32.6/36.6/37.1/41.1/43.6/46.6 min for bands 1-6 (the wing and the treasury are never counted: optional, paid from the slack); the clock is ceil((required + 20 s) x 1.25) to the minute (the tool alone gives 41/46/47/52/55/59). The 20 s is this unit's allowance for the lights-out set piece, which the tool walks as a plain room. Every band is at most 60 min, so D17's hour applies (no lockout of its own). Planning paces, not measured (XT1 timed no fight)
dungeons.design: Pass 3 (unit DG3-JUNGLE, 2026-10-10), after the owner's walk of pass 2 ('I see no diverging paths ... the optional paths didn't feel immense. And the parkour room should be longer'), on pass 2's rooms. The OUTER JUNGLE: the strangler thicket (maze), the troop's clearing (nest), north and up the root stair, the canopy crossing (the main parkour, six sections). The GORGE RIM is a three-way crossroads, every way in sight from its middle: the poachers' trail east (dark, a fight: the camp, with the cracked secret), the rope bridge north (sunlit, fast, a collapse that costs a fall) or the flooded stair south into the gorge (safe and long); all three meet in the wild orchard (resources). The TEMPLE: the colonnade of masks (ambush), the temple steps (the treasury, a vault, a side room off them), west along the cloister (the shortcut), down the well stair and east again UNDER the colonnade through the undercroft (dark) to the old shrine (safe room, healer). From the shrine a vine door leads to the WING: the strangler's climb thirty up, the high canopy (the hard parkour) and the high sanctum, where on some runs the PRIZE waits (Hakamo-o, from band 4 Zarude) and a balcony hides the seed idol. On one heal: the FALLEN COURT, the second crossroads: the glyph door (a puzzle) or round through the root crawl (dark, longer). The Tangle (mini-boss), the canopy closing over the hall (the set piece) and the altar (the Gardener). Fights never meet: a non-fight room stands between any two on every route

dungeons.design: Unit NEW-SWORDS (2026-10-11), authored to data/dungeon_prize_roster.json's field_of_swords on the hill keep theme. THE OUTER WORKS: the postern, the killing lanes (maze) between the curtain walls, the kennels (nest; the moat pool and the quartermaster's stores with the oath well are side rooms off it), north and up the cut stair onto the broken ramparts (the main parkour, six sections). THE BARBICAN is a three-way crossroads, every way in sight from its middle: the sally port east (dark, a fight: the guardroom, with the cracked secret), the wall-walk north (lit, fast, a collapse that costs a fall) or the moat south (flooded, safe and long); all three meet in the quarry yard (resources). THE INNER WARD: the gatehouse (a plates puzzle), the tiltyard (gauntlet), the inner ward steps (the paymaster's strongroom, a bank vault whose code is chalked in the kennels, the quarry yard and the tiltyard, is a side room off them), west along the chapel walk (the shortcut back into the tiltyard), down the cellar stair and east again UNDER the tiltyard through the gaol (dark) to the infirmary (safe room, healer). From the infirmary the sally tunnel leads to the WING: the watch stair thirty up, the broken spire (the hard parkour) and the field of swords, where from band 4 on some runs the PRIZE waits (a Sword of Justice, its paradox double, from band 5 Keldeo) and a balcony hides the broken hilt. On one heal: the GREAT HALL, the second crossroads: the war room (a lever puzzle) or round through the crypt (dark, longer). The champion's ring (mini-boss, a different fighter each run), the breach (the collapse set piece) and the high hall (the Castellan, two stages, a full heal between).
